content:
Hi everyone. I wanted to share with you the launch of the Association for Human Mathematics, which you can read more about at https://www.ahmath.org/.

I do not expect broad agreement from our community with the values promoted by this association; nevertheless, I encourage all of you to read about it and consider becoming a member. In particular, while it doesn't appear on the website, you will see in the registration form that the association will organize focused working-groups to help protecting different aspects of the mathematical community against the destructive intrusion of generative AI.

I believe that members of our community have a significant role to play in this endeavour, as we have been exposed somewhat earlier to the destructive behaviour of AI companies, and because Lean and Mathlib have unfortunatly become key infrastructure in these developments. Thus, I sincerely hope to see some of you join the association, and participate in its working groups :slight_smile:

Discussion should happen at: #general > Discussion: Association for Human Mathematics
